# Google Fiber

> Google Fiber delivers gigabit fiber optic internet with Wi-Fi 6E/7 routers, business solutions, and nationwide coverage across 20+ states.

Google Fiber provides ultra-high-speed residential and business internet services featuring speeds up to 8 gigabits, advanced mesh Wi-Fi connectivity, and comprehensive customer support. The service is available in select markets across the United States with plans starting at gigabit speeds.

- Google Fiber
- Gigabit Fiber Internet
